question_text: Discuss using unsupervised clustering to group customers with similar purchasing behaviour for a retailer.
adaptation_rationale: Makes the clustering mechanism explicit; no database-segmentation taxonomy beyond2027 clustering guidance is imposed.
solution: Clusters may reveal groups that respond to different products/offers and help allocate resources. But groups depend on features and similarity choices; superficially similar customers may have different needs, and small clusters may be unstable. Clusters should guide investigation rather than be treated as permanent facts about every person.
